system.description: • Effect: Choose one element — fire, cold, lightning, earth, water, or air. You have Resistance to its damage.

options.name: Fire
options.text: Resistance to fire damage (immune from 20th level).

options.name: Cold
options.text: Resistance to cold damage (immune from 20th level).

options.name: Lightning
options.text: Resistance to lightning damage (immune from 20th level).

options.name: Earth
options.text: Resistance to damage from earth (immune from 20th level; the GM says which damage that covers).

rules.value: Elemental Mastery (Earth): {1:resistance, 20:immunity} to earth damage (the GM's call which damage that is).

options.name: Water
options.text: Resistance to damage from water (immune from 20th level; the GM says which damage that covers).

rules.value: Elemental Mastery (Water): {1:resistance, 20:immunity} to water damage (the GM's call which damage that is).

options.name: Air
options.text: Resistance to damage from air (immune from 20th level; the GM says which damage that covers).

rules.value: Elemental Mastery (Air): {1:resistance, 20:immunity} to air damage (the GM's call which damage that is).
